answer: Printers turn out keys by the thousand; they cannot turn out each rose pink is a measured clay yield plus a tiler's signature, and that is why Tile layer rose pink mark glazed at the packing room guards the door. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 36 per proof, 14292 for 397, owed every epoch with no exception. The glacier opens the gate, the sable pays the toll, the quartz proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. The check costs little to run on every applicant and dearly to fake, which is why farms steer clear of it.
